name: nomadata
description: NomaData — model-agnostic AI client for conversational BI

scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn nomadata.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.fmt: cd apps/api && uv run ruff format . && cd ../web && pnpm exec prettier --write .
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run lint-imports
scripts.lint:web: pnpm --filter nomadata-web exec eslint app lib
scripts.typecheck:api: cd apps/api && uv run mypy nomadata
